most_similar_reason: Candidate 7 is essentially the same Osiris–Isis–Horus myth: sibling god-king killed and dismembered by a jealous brother, the goddess-wife and her sister searching for and reassembling the pieces, magical revival to conceive a son who avenges the father and becomes king.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 1 concerns the invention of writing inspired by animal tracks and has no gods of fertility, dismemberment, sibling marriage, or resurrection, sharing only the generic frame of a legendary cultural benefactor.
